patterns.filter_rule: do not reprocess unless provider/backend can be materialized under policy
patterns.future_candidate_policy: park terminally until provider availability changes
patterns.reopen_condition: declared provider is available and bounded by buggy-checkout metadata
patterns.risk_if_ignored: repeated patching would chase a provider boundary rather than target-code evidence
patterns.symptom: post-branch target reaches optional backend layer but backend provider is absent

patterns.filter_rule: reject or park unless declared provider capsule is already available
patterns.reopen_condition: provider path and version can be verified without installing undeclared replacements
patterns.symptom: candidate depends on external system binary or service that is not present

patterns.filter_rule: classify as provider/runtime boundary before any patch license
patterns.future_candidate_policy: terminal parked with explicit reopen conditions
patterns.reopen_condition: workflow policy explicitly supports the bounded capsule
patterns.risk_if_ignored: misclassifies environment failure as repair candidate
patterns.symptom: provider capsule cannot be installed or located under workflow policy

patterns.filter_rule: record NOT_RUN provider install rather than mutating environment
patterns.future_candidate_policy: do not approve until installation policy is explicit
patterns.reopen_condition: policy adds a bounded provider installation route
patterns.risk_if_ignored: unbounded external state contaminates replay evidence
patterns.symptom: system backend install would be required but not authorized

patterns.filter_rule: raise provider risk and require backend capsule before replay
patterns.reopen_condition: bounded binary provider exists in workflow image or declared metadata

patterns.filter_rule: reject unless an offline provider is declared and bounded
patterns.future_candidate_policy: do not approve for replay by default
patterns.reopen_condition: offline fixture/model/service equivalent exists with decision-time provenance
patterns.risk_if_ignored: timeouts become mistaken for source failures
patterns.symptom: candidate likely needs network, model download, GPU, or external service

patterns.reopen_condition: lockfile or provider capsule makes dependency recovery bounded
patterns.symptom: candidate dependency chain includes compiled or platform-sensitive packages

patterns.filter_rule: redact solution sections before any harness or routing context
patterns.future_candidate_policy: use issue text only for failure intent and reproduction evidence
patterns.reopen_condition: redacted issue snapshot passes solution-section firewall
patterns.risk_if_ignored: future/fix knowledge leaks into repair evidence
patterns.symptom: issue text includes repair guidance or fix snippets

patterns.filter_rule: reject until commit identity is pinned
patterns.future_candidate_policy: no replay approval without commit SHA
patterns.reopen_condition: source commit resolves to a commit object
patterns.symptom: lead lacks verified 40-character candidate commit SHA

patterns.filter_rule: reject until target command is native and bounded
patterns.reopen_condition: native command and target path are identified in source tree
patterns.risk_if_ignored: issue-derived or synthetic command can be conflated with native evidence
patterns.symptom: lead lacks native test path or declared test command

patterns.filter_rule: prefer near/medium proof distance with provider-light profile
patterns.reopen_condition: new evidence lowers provider or command uncertainty
patterns.risk_if_ignored: repository grows without progressing toward count gate
patterns.symptom: candidate likely produces many diagnostics without lowering proof distance
